method: Pre-fix capacity confirmation. Three actual rendered game documents and native keyboard at normal rAF, using the deterministic RTC transport fixture because managed WebRtcIPHandling disables non-proxied UDP. This is application/protocol integration, NOT native WebRTC or Wi-Fi validation. Pixel ratio .35 for concurrent software rendering; no simulation stepping.
